name: Hoco HC3 Bluetooth, TF Card, USB, AUX & FM Radio Supported True Wireless LED Flashing IPX4 Waterproof Speaker
description:
HC3 Bounce Wireless Speaker – Compact, Powerful, and Portable 🎵

Product Overview:
The HC3 Bounce Wireless Speaker is designed for music lovers who want high-quality sound on the go. Equipped with a 2400mAh battery, multiple playback modes, and a compact design, it’s perfect for home, travel, and outdoor use.

Specifications:

Model: HC3 Bounce

Bluetooth Version: V5.0 with JL chip for stable and fast connectivity

Battery Capacity: 2400mAh, charging time: ~3 hours

Playback Time: Up to 6 hours for calls or music

Speaker Units: Dual 52mm units, power: 5W x2

Playback Modes Supported: BT, TF card, USB, AUX, FM

Size: 194.4 × 81 × 82 mm

Weight: 598g

Key Features:

Superior Sound Quality: Dual 52mm speakers with 5W x2 power deliver rich, clear sound and deep bass.

Long Battery Life: 2400mAh battery provides up to 6 hours of continuous music or calls, perfect for trips and outdoor activities.

Multiple Connectivity Options: Supports Bluetooth, TF card, USB, AUX, and FM for versatile entertainment.

Portable & Compact: Lightweight and small, easy to carry anywhere.

Quick Charging: Fully charges in about 3 hours, so you can enjoy music faster.

Perfect For:

Outdoor adventures, picnics, and sports

Travel and portable entertainment

Home music, podcasts, and calls
